No class-diagram skill was available, so I drew this by hand from the production sources (`src/main`). Safelist's main collaborators are its own nested value types, the node types from `org.jsoup.nodes`, three helpers, and the two classes that use it: `Cleaner` (and its inner `CleaningVisitor`) and `Jsoup`.

    direction LR

        -Set~TagName~ tagNames
        -Map~TagName, Set~AttributeKey~~ attributes
        -Map~TagName, Map~AttributeKey, AttributeValue~~ enforcedAttributes
        -Map~TagName, Map~AttributeKey, Set~Protocol~~~ protocols
        -boolean preserveRelativeLinks
        +none()$ Safelist
        +simpleText()$ Safelist
        +basic()$ Safelist
        +basicWithImages()$ Safelist
        +relaxed()$ Safelist
        +Safelist()
        +Safelist(Safelist copy)
        +addTags(String...) Safelist
        +removeTags(String...) Safelist
        +addAttributes(String, String...) Safelist
        +removeAttributes(String, String...) Safelist
        +addEnforcedAttribute(String, String, String) Safelist
        +removeEnforcedAttribute(String, String) Safelist
        +preserveRelativeLinks(boolean) Safelist
        +preserveRelativeLinks() boolean
        +addProtocols(String, String, String...) Safelist
        +removeProtocols(String, String, String...) Safelist
        +isSafeTag(String) boolean
        +isSafeAttribute(String, Element, Attribute) boolean
        ~shouldAbsUrl(String, String) boolean
        +getEnforcedAttributes(String) Attributes
    }

    class TypedValue {
        <<abstract>>
        -String value
        +hashCode() int
        +equals(Object) boolean
        +toString() String
    }
    class TagName {
        ~valueOf(String)$ TagName
    }
    class AttributeKey {
        ~valueOf(String)$ AttributeKey
    }
    class AttributeValue {
        ~valueOf(String)$ AttributeValue
    }
    class Protocol {
        ~valueOf(String)$ Protocol
    }

    class Cleaner {
        -Safelist safelist
        +Cleaner(Safelist)
        +clean(Document) Document
        +isValid(Document) boolean
        +isValidBodyHtml(String) boolean
    }
    class CleaningVisitor {
        <<inner>>
        -int numDiscarded
        -Element root
        -Element destination
    }
    class Jsoup {
        +clean(String, String, Safelist)$ String
        +clean(String, Safelist)$ String
        +clean(String, String, Safelist, OutputSettings)$ String
        +isValid(String, Safelist)$ boolean
    }

    class Element
    class Attribute
    class Attributes
    class Validate {
        <<utility>>
    }
    class Normalizer {

    }

    Safelist +-- Protocol

    Safelist "1" *-- "*" TagName : tagNames
    Safelist "1" *-- "*" AttributeKey : attributes
    Safelist "1" *-- "*" AttributeValue : enforcedAttributes

    Safelist ..> Normalizer : uses
    Safelist ..> StringUtil : uses
